# AdSpyLab

> AdSpyLab is web2app competitor intelligence: what quiz-funnel brands advertise on
> Meta, Google and TikTok, how much and since when, which creatives they iterate, and what
> their funnels look like screen by screen — down to the paywall prices. Built for
> teams that run web-to-app subscription products (fitness, wellness, astrology,
> language learning, education, AI tools) and for the agencies that serve them.

Who it is for: growth and user-acquisition teams, creative strategists, founders and
analysts of web2app products. You do not need to know a competitor by name: a
category and a month are enough to start.

What you can look at: monthly counts of new ads per brand, advertiser page, landing
domain, funnel and language since 2025 (Meta) and Google Ads Transparency data by
domain, country and creative type; the creative library — concept families, reuse,
EU reach and rank movements, search by text or meaning; and the Funnels Library —
saved walk-throughs of live quiz funnels (every screen, question, answer, pixels,
payment provider, paywall plans and prices), re-walked over time so versions can be
compared. Only publicly available advertising data is used.

## Programmatic access (MCP)

- MCP server: https://adspylab.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 + PKCE; static keys
  for CLI clients from Settings → Agent access). Server card:
  https://adspylab.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json — the live list of tools,
  prompts and resources. Agent docs: https://adspylab.com/AGENTS.md
- A subscription with MCP access is required (the All-inclusive plan includes MCP and
  a monthly team credit allowance; one credit = one returned creative, one saved
  funnel screen or one analytics row). There is no anonymous or self-registered
  tier: the connector signs in with the account's web login.
- Connect from Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector →
  https://adspylab.com/mcp, then sign in. Claude Code:
  `claude mcp add --transport http adspylab https://adspylab.com/mcp`, restart the
  client, run /mcp to sign in. Cursor / Codex / VS Code: add a remote server of type
  streamable-http with the same URL.
- Start with the free `getting_started` tool (the capability guide) and the
  `adspylab://categories` resource for exact category names. Report tools
  (`competitor_report`, `category_report`, `funnel_report`) answer one job in one
  call and end with `done`; single-purpose tools follow. Every list is one page.
- A Claude Skill with playbooks per question: https://adspylab.com/mcp/skill.zip
  (SKILL.md at https://adspylab.com/mcp/skill/SKILL.md).

## Pages

- [Home](https://adspylab.com/): what AdSpyLab covers and the plans.
- [Pricing](https://adspylab.com/#pricing): Analytics, Ads Library, Funnels Library,
  or All-inclusive with MCP.
- [Reports](https://adspylab.com/reports/): published market reports.
- [Niches](https://adspylab.com/niches/): category pages — who advertises in a niche
  and how it moves month to month.
- [Brands](https://adspylab.com/brands/): public brand cards.
- [Guides](https://adspylab.com/guides/): how to read ad volume, creatives and funnels.
- Russian versions under https://adspylab.com/ru/ (reports, niches, brands, guides).
